The Human Inquisition tends to fight alongside other forces, deploying highly trained specialists to achieve their mysterious goals. Originally, the inquisition was established as diplomatic contacts and investigators within the scattered human colonies of Sirius. They came to rely on secrecy, vigilantism, and other underhanded methods, in order to gather information and neutralize threats. Their dubious reputation has made them pariahs to some, but the Inquisition continues to carry out their work of protecting humanity. The rise of a messianic figure known to history as the Founder resulted in a devastating war that soon engulfed Earth and its colonies. As the war grew more devastating, many survivors began to seek a... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/human-inquisition) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Inquisitorial Agent: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being fatigued when activated for the second time). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round. ### Special Rules Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Brutal Fighter: When in melee, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Caster Group: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round. Casting Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight with Caster, which gets -1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Delayed Action: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later). Evasive: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where all models have this rule. Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Hit & Run: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. Infiltrate: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit. Piercing Tag(X): Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(Y) on their weapons, where Y is the number of removed markers. Protected: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. Quick Readjustment: This model ignores penalties from shooting after moving when using Indirect weapons. Repel Ambushers: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit. Resistance: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Spell Accumulator(X): Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken. Spell Conduit: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken. Surge: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Surprise Attack(X): Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1). Takedown Shot: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make one extra attack against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown. Teleport: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions. Unpredictable Shooter: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. ### Aura Special Rules Bounding Aura: This model and its unit get Bounding. Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Defensive Growth Aura: This model and its unit get Defensive Growth. Furious Aura: This model and its unit get Furious. Precision Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee. Precision Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when shooting. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Resistance Aura: This model and its unit get Resistance. Shred in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Shred in melee. Stealth Aura: This model and its unit get Stealth. Read more ### Spells Psy-Injected Courage (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Electric Tempest (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. Calculated Foresight (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units gets Relentless against once (next time the effect would apply). Searing Burst (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits. Shock Speed (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply). Expel Threat (3): Pick one enemy model within 18", which takes 6 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. ### Units ### Heroes Inquisitor [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 60pts Heavy Pistol(12", A1, AP(1)), CCW(A2) Hero, Inquisitorial Agent, Tough(3)
